name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 - Security techniques - Extension to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27002 for privacy information management (PIMS) - Requirements and guidelines
description: ISO/IEC 27701 is the ISO privacy information management system (PIMS) extension to ISO/IEC 27001/27002, adding PII-controller controls (clause 7 / Annex A) and PII-processor controls (clause 8 / Annex B). The 2019 edition targeted here was withdrawn on 2025-10-14 and replaced by the standalone ISO/IEC 27701:2025 (transition window ~3 years); mappings and IDs reflect the 2019 structure as specified and should be re-verified against 2025 if the target migrates. Agent-responsibility-boundary caveat: most PIMS obligations (lawful basis, consent capture, privacy notices, PIAs, DPAs) are org/legal/D
jurisdiction: International (ISO/IEC). Designed as a regulation-agnostic PIMS; Annex D maps to EU GDPR.
regime_version: 2019 edition (published 2019-08-06); WITHDRAWN and superseded by ISO/IEC 27701:2025 on 2025-10-14, transition deadline 2025-10 + 3 years (~Oct 2028). This crosswalk targets the 2019 edition as specified.
